criteria.criterion: Run cargo test: a scratch-repository test lands the cutover job, then builds ONE job branch whose range holds an intervention commit (commit_with_staged), a records-only commit (Committer) and the job's landing commit, and lands it through land_pr with a squash merge. It asserts the squash commit on the base has no 'Athena-' line, and each of the three PR commits (reachable via the landing record's second parent) has no 'Athena-' line. The test fails without the change.
criteria.evidence: gh::tests::records_flow::post_c0_squash_landing_has_no_athena_trailers passed. post_c0_landing (gh.rs:4811) lands the cutover job, then builds commit_with_staged, commit_records and build_commit, and lands them through the free land_pr with squash: git, which is the production SquashText for Git. The test asserts that neither the squash message nor the merge text has an Athena- line, that the second parent equals the head, that the walk finds 3 commits with no Athena- line, and that the landing record's commits equal the walk. Without the strip, the commits would keep their Athena-Intervention and Athena-Job lines and these assertions would fail.

criteria.criterion: Run cargo test: in the same scratch repository the landing record classifies the three commits as declared_intervention, records_only and job_landing, and check_history and check_attribution pass on the post-C0 base (library-level; if a CLI-level athena check run is included in lifecycle.rs it has a clear assertion, otherwise it is omitted).
criteria.evidence: post_c0_squash_landing_is_classified_and_checks_pass passed. It asserts the kinds are [DeclaredIntervention, RecordsOnly, JobLanding] and that check_attribution has no findings. summary: Fail. Six of the eight criteria are met; criteria 2 and 6 are not. The core change works: after C0, commits made by Committer::build_commit_in and commit_with_staged, and the squash text land_pr picks, have no Athena- lines, and Co-Authored-By survives. One end-to-end test lands three commits (an intervention, a records-only commit and the job's landing commit) with a squash merge through land_pr, and none of them carries an Athena- line. Before the cutover shows, trailers are still written. The history check after C0 runs only secrets and attribution, and the gate drops only the invariant check. The docs match the code, and fmt, clippy and tests are clean. Criterion 2 is unmet: it says check_history passes on the post-C0 base, but the new test asserts check_history reports violations. They are legacy-rule violations on the scratch repository's own fake commits before C0, and none touches the post-C0 commits; a legacy-exempt record in the test setup would have made the check pass as the criterion asks. Criterion 6 is unmet: the post-C0 fallback was added to athena trace (status.rs) and the auditor (auditor.rs), but no test runs either one. The only test, in gh.rs, covers landed_commit and the shared helper, although the plan promised one test per file.
